body: FORMAL MILESTONE (no RH claim): the hWin shrink from discovery 0106 (WinCount: [Z-PT] faceSplit + 3e9 record shadow) is now OPERATIONAL AT THE ENDPOINT.  MODULE:  formal/RhAttack/RHEnd.lean Part B3 (66 lines added; the file's terminal endpoint variants now include a third restatement; build green in one shot; full tree re-verified at 17450 jobs, 0 errors; 0 sorry in RHEnd).  THEOREM:  rh_program78_winpt (q : ZeroSet) (hz78 : Z78.externalZeroFree78) (hqz : zeros) (honline : the named on-line sliver record) (Qside) (hs1 : the S1 witness) (hs3 : the S3 wire) (hPT : WinC.allOnLineUpTo q WinC.tPT) (hres : WinC.hWinFaceResidual q) (hS2low : the S2 low-band pin) : RH q.  BODY:  have hface : S4WC.hWinFace q := (WinC.faceSplit q hPT).mpr hres;  refine rh_program78 q ... hface ...  - the two-line composition relies on the definitional coincidence that S4WC.hWinFace q IS the hWin premise type of rh_program78 (S4WinCap restated it verbatim through the Z78P12 aliases in discovery 0105), so the derived face plugs straight into the endpoint with no adapter.  WHAT IT MEANS:  to run the endpoint program in the window regime, one no longer states 'the window squeeze holds on [1000, inf) x (0, 1/200)' as a named residual; one states (i) the CITED classical frontier [Z-PT] (every non-trivial zero with 0 < Im <= 30,610,046,000 is on the line - the rigorous interval-verified zero-isolation record, +- 2^-102, the end of the public stream; cited exactly like [Z78]) and (ii) the RESIDUAL: no off-line zero in (tPT, inf) x (0, 1/200).  The open height interval of the hWin residual at the endpoint is thus (3.06e10, inf) instead of [1000, inf) - a shrink by a factor of about 3e7 in height.  THE 3e9 RECORD SHADOW STAYS OUTSIDE:  WinCount.offExcessBound (with the pinned record counts Nline = 9064192826 and rvm3e9 = 9064192825.58 and the record's +-3 tolerance, the off-line excess below 3e9 is 0 or 2 - at most one orbit) is a record-derived CONSTRAINT on the same open region, intentionally not folded into the endpoint premises (the endpoint composes around CITED classical inputs + named residuals; record data enters via the measurement track).  HONESTY SPLIT  UNCHANGED:  [Z-PT] CITED (classical, docstring reference to Platt's interval isolation); the residual OPEN (no instrument in the tree reaches (tPT, inf) x (0, 1/200) - classical zero-free regions stop at Re > 1 - c/ln t, nowhere near Re = 1/2 +- 1/200, and the measured zero walk ends at the frontier); the endpoint statement rh_program78 itself UNTOUCHED (s1 and winpt are restatements that compose around it).
